title: How GPS Works in 60 Seconds 🛰️📍 #shorts
description:
GPS finds you using time, not magic. Satellites 20,200 km up carry atomic clocks and keep broadcasting the exact time and their position. Your phone measures how long each signal took to arrive, and with at least four satellites it works out exactly where you are. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#gps #satellite #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Without *Einstein's* relativity, GPS would drift by about *10 kilometers* every day.

steps.label: Satellites
steps.text: About *thirty* GPS satellites circle Earth, *20,200 km* up.

steps.label: Clocks
steps.text: Each one carries *atomic clocks* and keeps broadcasting the *exact time* and its position.

steps.label: Delay
steps.text: Your phone measures how long each signal took, and turns that delay into a *distance*.

steps.label: Four
steps.text: With *four* satellites, those distances meet at *one point*. That's you.

steps.label: Relativity
steps.text: Up there, clocks run about *38 microseconds* a day fast, so the system *corrects* them.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Time, distance, *position*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
